user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template defining an IAM role with a policy that allows EC2 instances to write logs to CloudWatch and read configuration from Parameter Store.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM role and instance profile for EC2 to write CloudWatch Logs and read SSM Parameter Store with optional KMS decryption.

Parameters:
  RoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional explicit name for the IAM role. Leave blank to let CloudFormation name it.
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]{0,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Role name can include alphanumeric and +=,.@- and be up to 64 characters.
  LogGroupNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "/ec2/"
    Description: Prefix of CloudWatch Logs log group names EC2 instances are allowed to write to (e.g., /ec2/ or /app/prod-).
  ParameterPathPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "/app/"
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path prefix EC2 instances can read from (must start with '/'), e.g., /app/prod/.
    AllowedPattern: '^/.*'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a forward slash (/).
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional KMS Key or Alias ARN for decrypting SecureString SSM parameters. Leave blank to allow only the AWS managed SSM KMS key (alias/aws/ssm).
    AllowedPattern: '^$|arn:aws:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:\d{12}:(key|alias)\/[A-Za-z0-9/_+=,.@-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid KMS key or alias ARN.

Conditions:
  HasRoleName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RoleName, ""]]
  HasKmsKeyArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, ""]]

Resources:
  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      RoleName: !If [HasRoleName, !Ref RoleName, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2CloudWatchLogsAndSSMAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsCreateGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsGroupAndStreamMgmt
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupNamePrefix}*
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsPutEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupNamePrefix}*:log-stream:*
              - Sid: SSMParameterRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${ParameterPathPrefix}*
              - Sid: KMSDecryptForSSMParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !If
                  - HasKmsKeyArn
                  - - !Sub arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/aws/ssm
                    - !Ref KmsKeyArn
                  - !Sub arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/aws/ssm
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub ssm.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
                  StringLike:
                    kms:EncryptionContext:aws:ssm:parameterarn: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${ParameterPathPrefix}*

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole

Outputs:
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for EC2 instances.
    Value: !GetAtt EC2InstanceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2InstanceRoleArn
  RoleNameOut:
    Description: Name of the IAM role for EC2 instances.
    Value: !Ref EC2InstanceRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2InstanceRoleName
  InstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM instance profile.
    Value: !GetAtt EC2InstanceProfile.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2InstanceProfileArn
  InstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the IAM instance profile.
    Value: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EC2InstanceProfileName
